known_defects: geostatspy.kb2d: block discretisation (nxdis*nydis > 1) raises NameError 'real' and its inner covariance loop sums only the last j; do not use as a reference for block kriging
geostatspy.kb2d returns the grid with row 0 = northernmost (y flipped)
geostatspy.gamv counts the self-pair at lag 0 (GSLIB convention): npairs[0] = n, or 2n for an omnidirectional variogram

geostatspy.nscore: the score of the minimum sample is taken from the neighbouring rows of the transform table (-2.20 instead of -2.50 for the reference set); BF2 stats/transforms.py matches it to 1e-6 elsewhere
